hypothesis: active value depends jointly on evidence reliability, availability delay, coverage, and confidence; all methods share target/checkpoint denominator

contract.shared_evidence: one noisy source signal per target reused after availability
contract.delay: number of initial checkpoints without evidence
contract.coverage: target-level probability that evidence ever becomes available
contract.no_extra_definition: single retrieval only when delay is zero, then carry-forward
contract.source_rr_definition: independent noisy retrieval at every available checkpoint
contract.active_definition: shared signal with configured p_high/(1-p_high) confidence
